correctness.rationale: For all integers m≥2, positive prices and positive budgets, the star leaf-block Schur equivalence is exact. Strong convex duality yields t_i=max(1−λ,√(α/p_i)) and unique endpoint/root alpha; Perron-positive lowest eigenvectors imply uniqueness and strict budget use; convex epigraph proves concavity; monotonic g implies activation. The exact two-price and final affine regimes follow algebraically. The packaged standard-library checker passed 14,549 supplemental finite checks, not offered as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The naturally priced budgeted Laplacian pinning problem is important to sparse-network consensus design. This supplies the complete all-m/all-positive-prices/all-budget optimizer, scalar computation, unique gains, irreversible cheapest-leaf activation, hub switch, exact affine high-rate tail, and closed two-price phase transition. These structural properties are not textbook normalization checks or arbitrary finite calculations, and the scope remains fixed-unit star networks.
